test_cases.name: backend_only_stops
test_cases.input: /impeccable tối ưu query SQL của service orders
assertions: Says the input is backend-only or non-UI and stops before anything else
Does NOT read the impeccable skill

test_cases.name: reads_skill_and_overrides
assertions: Reads .agents/skills/agentic-os/impeccable/SKILL.md in full
Reads every .agents/skills/impeccable/... path as .agents/skills/agentic-os/impeccable/...

test_cases.name: first_word_subcommand_loads_reference
assertions: Loads reference/layout.md
Applies it to `checkout form` as the target

test_cases.name: empty_input_lists_subcommands
assertions: Lists the available sub-commands from reference/
Asks which one and does NOT auto-run any

test_cases.name: vendored_folder_not_edited
test_cases.input: /impeccable sửa luôn SKILL.md của impeccable cho gọn
assertions: Does NOT edit anything under .agents/skills/agentic-os/impeccable/
Says repo rules for it live in the router or its Local Overrides

test_cases.name: missing_reference_not_reconstructed
assertions: Says in one line that the reference is missing
Continues from SKILL.md plus the references that exist
Does NOT reconstruct the missing content from memory

test_cases.name: spec_stage_fills_every_design_slot
assertions: Routes the intent path to the Spec stage, not the design-brief branch
Fills every ## Design slot: Mode, Mirrors, Structure, Tokens, States, Responsive, Copy, Interaction and a11y, Acceptance checks
Tokens slot ends with the line `no new hue, token or shadow`
Reads craft-floor.md even though no code is edited

test_cases.name: build_stage_builds_verbatim_and_records_evidence
assertions: Builds strings verbatim and components and tokens as named in ## Design
Runs impeccable detect, the build, tests, and desktop 1440px plus mobile 390px screenshots of every listed state
Records each acceptance check with evidence under the task in the plan file

test_cases.name: deviation_goes_to_update_spec
test_cases.input: /impeccable build, spec ghi 32px nhưng thực tế cần 36px
assertions: Stops instead of deviating in code
Runs /update-spec which patches ## Design
